title: Trust in the Lord with All Your Heart

questions.question: What should you trust in the Lord with?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:5 (ESV): "Trust in the Lord with all your heart,"

questions.question: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:6 (ESV): "In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make straight your paths."

questions.question: Do not be wise in your own what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:7 (ESV): "Be not wise in your own eyes;"

questions.question: Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:9 (ESV): "Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce;"

questions.question: The Lord reproves him whom he loves, as a father the son in whom he what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:12 (ESV): "as a father the son in whom he delights."

questions.question: Let not steadfast love and faithfulness forsake you; bind them around your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:3 (ESV): "bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart."

questions.question: It will be healing to your flesh and refreshment to your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:8 (ESV): "It will be healing to your flesh and refreshment to your bones."

questions.question: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, and the man who gets what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:13 (ESV): "Blessed is the one who finds wisdom, and the one who gets understanding,"

questions.question: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her; those who hold her fast are called what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:18 (ESV): "those who hold her fast are called blessed."

questions.question: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:27 (ESV): "Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it."

questions.question: The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:19 (ESV): "The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens;"

questions.question: Do not be afraid of sudden terror or of the ruin of the wicked, when it does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:25 (ESV): "Do not be afraid of sudden terror or of the ruin of the wicked, when it comes,"

questions.question: The curse of the Lord is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the dwelling of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:33 (ESV): "but he blesses the dwelling of the righteous."

questions.question: Toward the scorners he is scornful, but to the humble he gives what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:34 (ESV): "but to the humble he gives favor."

questions.question: The wise will inherit honor, but fools get what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:35 (ESV): "The wise will inherit honor, but fools get disgrace."

key_verse_text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make straight your paths.
